reading.title: Good News at Last
reading.text: Yesterday evening my family was watching the local news on TV. The reporter said that our town will get a new sports centre next year. It was great news for all the young people here. My brother, who plays basketball, jumped up and shouted with joy. Then the reporter said the news report would continue with the weather. Mum switched off the television and said, "Let's have a special dinner!" We celebrated together. Dad read the latest news again online, just to be sure it was true.

reading.title: Waiting for the Mail
reading.text: Every day at noon, I wait for the mail carrier at our gate. Most of the mail is junk mail, but today there was a surprise. I found a parcel from my aunt in Canada. She sent it by air mail, and it took only one week. Inside there was a book and a short note. I immediately wrote her an email to say thank you. Then I checked my other mail: a bill for Dad and a postcard for my sister. I put everything in the kitchen and told my family about the parcel.

reading.text: A new café opened on our street last month. At first nobody knew about it, so the owner, Mrs Rose, decided to put an advert in the local newspaper.
